symptom: `describe layout` prints an empty body for a layout built on another layout (ConversationalUI.Layout_MasterBase on Atlas_Core.Atlas_Default), and the output is refused with `declares no placeholders at all` (MDL081)
cause: Such a layout keeps its tree in `Content.LayoutCall` — a `Forms$LayoutCall` to the outer layout whose `Forms$FormCallArgument`s hold the placeholders — and `Content.Widgets` is `[]`. Nothing in mxcli modelled it: `pages.Layout` had no call, the describer read only `Content.Widgets`, and gen bound `WebLayoutContent`'s call to `FormCall` (a page's key), so it neither decoded a stored call nor wrote one where Studio Pro looks
insight: **No local fixture had one** — PedApp, TestApp and every Atlas layout store `LayoutCall: null`; a downloaded marketplace package (Conversational UI 7.3.1) held the first Studio Pro-authored nested layout, and comparing its BSON is what exposed the gen key (`FormCall` vs `LayoutCall`), which the key-audit ledger missed because gen's key matched no metamodel name. The MDL reuses the page body: `Layout:` in the header, `placeholder X { … }` fills the outer X, a bodiless `placeholder Main` inside declares the inner slot. Controls: reverting the fix fails all seven tests with the reported MDL081 / empty body; reverting only the gen override fails the BSON test with `keys = [$ID $Type LayoutType FormCall Widgets]`. On mx 11.6.6 the written layout checks 0 errors, and a page binding an undeclared placeholder of it fails CE1613, so mx does resolve the inner placeholders
